stem: Draw one of the axes of symmetry of circle M. Drag both ends of the segment onto the circle so that it lies along an axis of symmetry.
solution: An axis of symmetry of a circle is a straight line through its centre M.
Its two ends on the circle give a segment through M, that is a diameter.
Place one end on the circle, then place the other end on the circle on the opposite side so the segment passes through M.

hints.text: An axis of symmetry must pass through the centre M. Check where your segment crosses relative to M.
Both ends of the segment must lie on the circle itself. Check that each end touches the circle.

notes: Axis of symmetry drawn as a diameter; the line L in the book is extended, here its diameter segment is graded.
